requirements.text: At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
with 3–4 years of professional experience to design, develop, evaluate, and implement data science and machine-learning solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, SQL, machine learning, statistical analysis, and data visualization, along with the ability to independently drive analytical projects and communicate results to technical and business stakeholders.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, query optimization, and data aggregation.
pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, Regression, Classification, Clustering, Ensemble Methods, Feature Engineering, Model Optimization, Model Evaluation
Hands-on experience with pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, and related data-science frameworks.
Experience with feature engineering, model validation, hyperparameter tuning, and model performance evaluation.
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization technologies.
Experience working with large datasets and modern cloud/data platforms.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Experience developing end-to-end machine-learning solutions.
Experience deploying machine-learning models into production environments.
Knowledge of MLOps and model lifecycle management.
Experience with NLP, time-series forecasting, recommendation systems, or deep learning.
Experience with Spark/PySpark for large-scale data processing.
Familiarity with cloud-based machine-learning services.
Knowledge of A/B testing and advanced statistical methods.
Experience building automated data science and machine-learning pipelines.
Ability to mentor junior data scientists and collaborate across technical teams.
Cloud, Data Science, Machine Learning, or Analytics certifications are a plus.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, SQL, machine learning, statistical analysis, and data visualization, along with the ability to independently drive analytical projects and communicate results to technical and business stakeholders.
